newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wienerberger Q1 group profit, sales up.
newsitem.headline: Wienerberger Q1 group profit, sales up.

text.p: Austrian brick maker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie reported on Tuesday a group pretax profit of 36 million schillings for the first quarter after a loss of 30 million in the year-ago period.

In a statement, the group said earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) rose to 117 million schillings from 65 million a year earlier. Group sales were up at 3.37 billion schillings from 2.77 billion in the same period of 1995.
"The first quarter is traditionally weak in the building materials industry and therefore little can be deduced from it," Wienerberger said in a statement. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
